scope: Independent TH10 native full-credit comparison of PPO2 against the same on-policy PPO2 minibatches with a learned future-loss auxiliary. Full original Normal Reimu A, no Continue, both frozen.
matching: Same physical host per controller seed. Original RNG uncontrolled. Seeds 714001-3 PPO2 first; 714004-6 auxiliary first. Run serially with respect to warm qualification and PPO3 evaluation.
